title: Welcome, Let’s Talk About Our PureHarvest
faq1Q: How long does it take for my fresh food to be delivered?
faq1A: Orders placed before 2 PM are typically delivered the same day. For orders placed after 2 PM, we guarantee delivery by the next morning to ensure maximum freshness.
faq2Q: How do you ensure the freshness of produce?
faq2A: Our fruits and vegetables are sourced directly from local farms. We use temperature-controlled vehicles to maintain the cold chain from the farm directly to your doorstep.
faq3Q: What is your return and refund policy for perishable items?
faq3A: If you are unsatisfied with the quality of any perishable item, please contact our support team within 24 hours of delivery with a photo. We will gladly issue a refund or a replacement.
faq4A: We partner with farmers who follow sustainable and organic farming practices. While not all items carry an official organic certification, they are grown without synthetic pesticides or harmful chemicals.
faq5Q: Can I schedule a specific delivery time?
faq5A: Yes! During checkout, you can select a delivery window that works best for you. Our delivery partners will do their best to arrive within that designated timeframe.
